title: Concept Probe Calibration: Are Probe Scores Meaningful as Probabilities

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Plausible chain: calibrated scores enable graded safety decisions rather than binary thresholds, improving monitoring utility. However, the improvement from binary to calibrated is incremental rather than enabling a fundamentally new capability.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Calibration methods (Platt scaling, temperature scaling, isotonic regression) are standard sklearn operations. Requires existing probe outputs and human safety ratings for validation. Medium compute is more than sufficient. Well within beginner reach.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Tightly scoped: apply three calibration methods to existing probe outputs, measure calibration error, compare to human ratings. Clear deliverable: reliability diagrams and calibration error metrics. Completable well within 30 hours.
